To modify the formula to write results to AB26:NW35 (which is 10 rows × 360 columns instead of 360 rows × 1 column), you need to change the orientation from vertical to horizontal. Here's the modified formula:

```excel
=CMPGetResults(IF(AC6="Base",Z6,Z7),AE6&"_values","varray",TRUE,"row_offset",2,"col_offset",-1,"row_start",AJ6,"row_limit",AK6,"transpose",TRUE)
```

Key changes:
1. Changed `"col_start"` to `"row_start"` - since data will now span across columns, the start parameter applies to rows
2. Changed `"col_limit"` to `"row_limit"` - the limit now applies to rows instead of columns
3. Added `"transpose",TRUE` - this will transpose the data from vertical to horizontal orientation

This assumes that:
- AJ6 and AK6 contain values that will appropriately limit the data to fit within the 10-row range (rows 26-35)
- The CMPGetResults function supports a "transpose" parameter

If the function doesn't support "transpose", you might need:

```excel
=CMPGetResults(IF(AC6="Base",Z6,Z7),AE6&"_values","varray",TRUE,"row_offset",2,"col_offset",-1,"orientation","horizontal","row_start",AJ6,"row_limit",AK6)
```
